intent.raw_query: Bali for solo traveler, $1500 budget, beaches and yoga, July 2026 from LA

selected_hotel.name: Campuhan Ridge Walk, Ubud Boutique Stay

experiences.name: Sunrise Yoga at Campuhan Ridge Walk
experiences.description: Join an outdoor sunrise yoga session along the scenic Campuhan Ridge Walk in Ubud, surrounded by lush jungle and rice paddies. Many local instructors offer small group classes here, combining gentle Hatha or Vinyasa flow with breathtaking natural views. A deeply restorative and spiritual experience unique to Bali.

experiences.name: Seminyak Beach Sunset & Surf Lesson
experiences.description: Take a beginner-friendly surf lesson on the golden sands of Seminyak Beach, one of Bali's most beautiful and vibrant stretches of coastline. After your lesson, relax and watch the legendary Bali sunset with a fresh coconut in hand. Instructors are certified and equipment is included in the price.

experiences.name: Multi-Day Yoga Retreat at The Yoga Barn
experiences.description: Spend several sessions at The Yoga Barn, Ubud's most iconic wellness center offering daily classes in Kundalini, Yin, Ashtanga, and meditation. With a serene jungle setting, healing pools, and a holistic café on site, this is the ultimate yoga immersion for any level of practitioner visiting Bali.

experiences.name: Nusa Penida Island Day Trip & Kelingking Beach
experiences.description: Take a fast boat from Sanur to Nusa Penida island and visit the jaw-dropping Kelingking Beach, known for its dramatic T-Rex shaped cliff and turquoise waters. Snorkel with manta rays at Manta Point and explore Crystal Bay. This is one of the most visually stunning beach experiences in all of Southeast Asia.

experiences.name: Balinese Cooking Class & Ubud Market Tour
experiences.description: Start your morning at the vibrant Ubud Traditional Market to source fresh local ingredients with your guide, then head to a family-run kitchen to learn how to prepare authentic Balinese dishes like Nasi Goreng, Satay Lilit, and Lawar. A hands-on cultural and culinary experience that connects you deeply with Balinese traditions.

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Bali
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

hotel.name: Campuhan Ridge Walk, Ubud Boutique Stay

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Ngurah Rai International Airport at 13:00 — skip morning slot as flight lands at noon
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Ngurah Rai International Airport, clear customs and immigration. Take a pre-booked shared shuttle or Grab ride (~IDR 150,000–200,000) to Campuhan Ridge Walk, Ubud Boutique Stay. Check in, freshen up, and take a gentle stroll along the iconic Campuhan Ridge Walk trail — a free, scenic 2 km path through lush green hills and rice paddies right outside your doorstep.
day_by_day.evening: Explore Ubud's Jalan Raya Ubud (main street) on foot. Visit the lively Ubud Night Market (Pasar Senggol) for cheap local bites and souvenirs. Settle in early to recover from travel.

meals.breakfast: Eat at the airport or on the plane before landing
meals.lunch: Grab a quick meal at a local warung near the hotel upon arrival — try Nasi Campur for IDR 20,000–35,000
meals.dinner: Ubud Night Market — try Sate Lilit, Martabak, or Nasi Goreng for IDR 15,000–40,000 per dish

day_by_day.notes: Day 1 activities begin only after 13:00 arrival. Exchange some cash at the airport (avoid hotel exchange rates). Download Grab app for affordable transport. Stay hydrated — warm weather around 25°C.

day_by_day.morning: Join a free or donation-based sunrise yoga session at one of Ubud's community yoga spots near the Campuhan Ridge Walk. Alternatively, do a self-guided morning walk along the ridge at sunrise (~6:00 AM) for stunning misty valley views — completely free.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the sacred Pura Gunung Lebah temple at the base of the Campuhan Ridge (free entry, sarong required). Then explore Ubud Art Market (Pasar Seni) for local handicrafts and practice bargaining. Walk to Ubud Palace (Puri Saren) — free to view the exterior and courtyard.
day_by_day.evening: Watch a traditional Kecak Fire Dance performance at Pura Dalem Ubud or Arma Museum (~IDR 100,000–150,000 per person). A must-do cultural experience.

meals.breakfast: Warung Babi Guling Ibu Oka nearby — try Nasi Babi Guling for IDR 50,000–80,000, or grab a simple fruit plate from a street vendor
meals.lunch: Warung Teges or a local warung near Ubud Market — Gado-Gado or Nasi Campur for IDR 20,000–40,000
meals.dinner: Warung Biah Biah on Jl. Goutama — cozy local warung with Balinese dishes under IDR 60,000

day_by_day.notes: Bring a sarong (or rent one for IDR 10,000–15,000) for temple visits. The Kecak Dance is best booked in the afternoon to secure seats. Carry small change for market purchases.

day_by_day.morning: Morning yoga class at Yoga Barn in Ubud (IDR 130,000–160,000 per drop-in class) — one of Bali's most famous yoga studios. Choose a Hatha or Vinyasa class starting at 7:30 or 9:00 AM. The serene jungle setting makes this exceptional value.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Tegalalang Rice Terraces (~20 min by scooter from Ubud, IDR 15,000 entry). Walk the terraced paths, take photos, and enjoy the panoramic views. Rent a scooter for the day (~IDR 60,000–80,000) for maximum freedom.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud and browse the shops along Monkey Forest Road. Visit the Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary (IDR 80,000 entry) just before closing time for discounted entry or enjoy from outside the gates for free.

meals.breakfast: Smoothie bowl or banana pancakes at a local café near Yoga Barn — IDR 30,000–55,000
meals.lunch: Warungs near Tegalalang Rice Terraces — Nasi Goreng or Mie Goreng for IDR 25,000–45,000
meals.dinner: Warung Ibu Oka 2 or Warung Sopa on Jl. Sugriwa — vegetarian-friendly Balinese food for IDR 40,000–70,000

day_by_day.notes: Scooter rental requires an international driving permit. If not confident riding, hire a local driver for the day (~IDR 350,000–500,000 for 8 hours, shareable with fellow travelers). Wear sunscreen — UV is strong even on cloudy days.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning visit to Tirta Empul Temple (holy spring water temple, ~30 min from Ubud) — entry IDR 50,000. Witness or participate in the traditional purification bathing ritual in sacred spring pools. Arrive by 8:00 AM to beat crowds.
day_by_day.afternoon: Stop at Gunung Kawi Temple complex on the way back (IDR 50,000 entry) — ancient rock-cut shrines carved into a cliff face. Explore the lush ravine and rice terraces surrounding the site.
day_by_day.evening: Relax back at the hotel and do a self-guided sunset yoga practice on the Campuhan Ridge. Then enjoy a quiet evening on Ubud's Jl. Dewi Sita street — browse art galleries and small boutiques.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast at the hotel or grab a Jaja Bali (traditional rice cake) from a roadside vendor — IDR 5,000–15,000
meals.lunch: Local warung near Tirta Empul — Nasi Campur for IDR 25,000–40,000
meals.dinner: Warung Mendez on Jl. Dewi Sita — authentic Balinese cuisine with generous portions under IDR 75,000

day_by_day.notes: Dress modestly for temple visits (shoulders and knees covered). Sarongs and sashes are provided at temples for a small donation. Bring a waterproof bag if you plan to participate in the purification ritual.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to Seminyak and Kuta beaches (approx. 1.5 hours from Ubud by shuttle — IDR 50,000–80,000 one way via Perama or shared shuttle). Arrive at Seminyak Beach by mid-morning for a swim and beach walk. Seminyak has a more relaxed vibe than Kuta.
day_by_day.afternoon: Walk south along the beach to Kuta Beach — one of Bali's most famous surf breaks. Watch local surfers or try a beginner surf lesson (~IDR 150,000–200,000 for 1–2 hours including board rental). Plenty of budget surf schools along the beach.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the famous Kuta sunset from the beach — completely free and spectacular. Then take a shared shuttle or Grab back to Ubud.

meals.breakfast: Eat before departure at a Ubud warung — Bubur Ayam (rice porridge) for IDR 15,000–25,000
meals.lunch: Warung near Kuta Beach — Nasi Goreng Seafood or fresh coconut for IDR 30,000–50,000
meals.dinner: Pick up a takeaway Nasi Bungkus (wrapped rice meal) from a warung on the way back to Ubud — IDR 15,000–30,000

day_by_day.notes: Book the shuttle in advance from your hotel reception. Kuta can be crowded and touristy — keep belongings secure. Seminyak is slightly more upscale but free to visit beaches. July is peak season so beaches will be busy.

day_by_day.morning: Morning yoga at Yoga Barn or a free outdoor yoga session on the Campuhan Ridge Walk. Practice mindfulness and breathwork as the morning mist lifts over the valley — a deeply restorative experience unique to Ubud.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Penestanan village (a short walk from Campuhan Ridge Walk) — a quiet artists' village with rice field paths, small galleries, and traditional Balinese family compounds. Completely free to explore.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a Legong Dance performance at Puri Saren (Ubud Palace) — IDR 80,000–100,000. Performances typically start at 7:30 PM and last about 1 hour. The open-air palace courtyard setting is magical.

meals.breakfast: Café Wayan on Monkey Forest Road — banana pancakes or eggs with toast for IDR 35,000–55,000
meals.lunch: Cook your own meal or buy fresh produce and snacks from Ubud Traditional Market (Pasar Ubud) — budget IDR 20,000–30,000
meals.dinner: Warung Kopi Desa near the palace — local Balinese dishes for IDR 35,000–65,000

day_by_day.notes: Penestanan is best explored on foot — wear comfortable shoes. The rice field paths can be muddy after rain, so check the weather. Ubud Palace performances are seasonal — confirm schedule at the hotel reception.

day_by_day.morning: Full-day beach excursion to Sanur Beach (approx. 1 hour from Ubud). Sanur is calm, shallow, and family-friendly — perfect for swimming and snorkeling. Rent a bicycle along the beachfront promenade (IDR 30,000–50,000 per hour) and cycle the scenic coastal path.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a short boat to Nusa Lembongan island from Sanur harbor (fast boat ~IDR 200,000–250,000 return, 30 min crossing). Explore the island's stunning beaches — Dream Beach and Mushroom Bay are free to access. Snorkel or swim in crystal-clear waters.
day_by_day.evening: Return boat to Sanur and take a shuttle back to Ubud. Enjoy a quiet evening at the hotel.

meals.breakfast: Eat before departure — simple toast and coffee at a local café for IDR 20,000–35,000
meals.lunch: Warung on Nusa Lembongan — fresh grilled fish or Nasi Campur for IDR 40,000–70,000
meals.dinner: Warung near Sanur harbor before heading back, or pick up food in Ubud on arrival — IDR 30,000–50,000

day_by_day.notes: This is a longer day — start early (7:00 AM departure from Ubud). Book the Nusa Lembongan fast boat in advance during July (peak season). Bring sunscreen, a hat, snorkel gear (or rent on the island for IDR 50,000), and a light rain jacket.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery morning. Sleep in, do a gentle yoga stretch in your room or on the hotel terrace. Enjoy a slow breakfast and journaling session overlooking the Campuhan valley.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the Blanco Renaissance Museum (IDR 80,000 entry) — a flamboyant museum dedicated to Spanish-Balinese artist Don Antonio Blanco, perched dramatically above the Campuhan River. Just a short walk from your hotel. Then visit the nearby Neka Art Museum (IDR 75,000) showcasing traditional and contemporary Balinese art.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset walk along the Campuhan Ridge — the golden hour light on the green hills is breathtaking. Then enjoy a relaxed dinner on Ubud's main street.

meals.breakfast: Lazy breakfast at the hotel or a nearby café — fruit salad, yogurt, and coffee for IDR 30,000–50,000
meals.lunch: Warung near the museums — Soto Ayam (chicken soup) or Gado-Gado for IDR 25,000–40,000
meals.dinner: Warung Biah Biah or Warung Teges — local favorites with meals under IDR 60,000

day_by_day.notes: Day 8 is intentionally slower-paced to avoid burnout mid-trip. The museums are walking distance from Campuhan Ridge Walk accommodation. Check museum opening hours (typically 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM).

day_by_day.morning: Early morning hike to Mount Batur volcano (active volcano, 1,717 m) — depart Ubud by 2:00–3:00 AM for a sunrise trek. Hire a local guide (~IDR 350,000–450,000 per person including guide fee and entry). Reach the summit by sunrise (~6:00 AM) for panoramic views over Lake Batur and neighboring peaks.
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend Mount Batur and soak in natural hot springs at the base (Toya Devasya or local hot springs — IDR 50,000–150,000). Return to Ubud by early afternoon for rest.
day_by_day.evening: Early dinner and early bedtime to recover from the pre-dawn start.

meals.breakfast: Simple packed breakfast provided by most tour guides at the summit (boiled eggs cooked in volcanic steam!)
meals.lunch: Local warung near Kintamani village on the way back — Nasi Campur with lake views for IDR 30,000–50,000
meals.dinner: Light meal at Ubud warung — Mie Goreng or soup for IDR 25,000–45,000

day_by_day.notes: Book the Mount Batur sunrise trek through your hotel or a local agency the day before. Bring warm layers (it gets cold at the summit — around 10–15°C), a headlamp, and sturdy shoes. This is a moderate hike suitable for most fitness levels. Stay hydrated. July weather is generally clear — great visibility expected.

day_by_day.morning: Recovery morning after the Mount Batur trek. Attend a late morning yoga class at Yoga Barn (10:00 AM Yin Yoga or Restorative class — IDR 130,000–160,000) to stretch tired muscles and restore energy.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Elephant Cave (Goa Gajah) archaeological site (~5 km from Ubud center, IDR 50,000 entry). Explore the 9th-century rock-carved cave temple, bathing pools, and surrounding jungle. Then stop at Yeh Pulu relief carvings nearby (IDR 15,000) — a lesser-known but fascinating ancient site.
day_by_day.evening: Browse Ubud's Jl. Hanoman street for budget shopping — local batik fabrics, silver jewelry, and handmade goods. Practice bargaining for the best prices.

meals.breakfast: Smoothie and toast at a café near Yoga Barn — IDR 30,000–50,000
meals.lunch: Warung near Goa Gajah — Nasi Campur or Ayam Betutu (slow-cooked Balinese chicken) for IDR 35,000–60,000
meals.dinner: Warung Ibu Oka or local warung on Jl. Hanoman — budget Balinese feast for IDR 40,000–70,000

day_by_day.notes: Goa Gajah is easily reached by scooter or a short taxi ride. Sarong required for temple entry. The cave interior is small and atmospheric — worth the visit. Combine with Yeh Pulu for a half-day cultural exploration.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to Balangan Beach and Bingin Beach in the Bukit Peninsula (approx. 1.5–2 hours from Ubud). These are two of Bali's most beautiful and budget-friendly beaches — dramatic cliffs, white sand, and turquoise water. Balangan is great for swimming; Bingin is a famous surf spot.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Bingin Beach's laid-back surf culture. Watch experienced surfers tackle the reef break. Relax on the beach, swim in the clear water, or hike the cliff paths between beaches. Padang Padang Beach is a short walk away (IDR 10,000 entry).
day_by_day.evening: Head back toward Ubud. Stop in Seminyak or Canggu for a budget sunset dinner before the shuttle ride home.

meals.breakfast: Eat before departure in Ubud — Bubur Ayam or banana pancakes for IDR 20,000–40,000
meals.lunch: Warung on Bingin Beach cliff — fresh coconut, Nasi Goreng, or grilled corn for IDR 30,000–55,000
meals.dinner: Warung in Canggu or Seminyak on the way back — Nasi Campur or fresh juice for IDR 35,000–65,000

day_by_day.notes: Hire a driver for this day trip (IDR 400,000–500,000 for the day) as the Bukit Peninsula roads are steep and winding — not ideal for beginner scooter riders. Bring cash as ATMs are scarce in the Bukit area. July swell can be large — exercise caution when swimming near surf breaks.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise walk along the Campuhan Ridge Walk — take your time to appreciate the misty green hills, swaying coconut palms, and temple bells echoing through the valley. A peaceful, meditative way to near the end of your trip.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Pura Taman Saraswati (Lotus Temple) in central Ubud — free entry to the exterior, beautiful lotus pond and ornate carvings. Then explore the Ubud Traditional Market one last time for final souvenir shopping. Head to a local spa for a budget traditional Balinese massage (IDR 80,000–150,000 for 60–90 minutes) — well-deserved after 12 days of adventures.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at a slightly nicer local restaurant to celebrate the trip. Catch a final cultural performance if available.

meals.breakfast: Final breakfast at a favorite local warung — Nasi Goreng, fresh fruit, and Balinese coffee (Kopi Bali) for IDR 25,000–45,000
meals.lunch: Warung near the Lotus Temple — light lunch of Gado-Gado or spring rolls for IDR 25,000–40,000
meals.dinner: Splurge slightly at Warung Sopa or Bebek Bengil (Duck Restaurant) — treat yourself to Balinese duck or suckling pig for IDR 80,000–150,000

day_by_day.notes: Book the traditional massage in advance as good budget spas fill up quickly in peak season. Pack souvenirs carefully — check airline baggage allowances. Confirm your departure transfer for Day 13.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in Ubud. Wake up early for one last meditation or yoga session on the Campuhan Ridge. Pack bags, check out of the hotel, and store luggage if needed. Take a final walk through the rice paddies near Penestanan village.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on departure flight time, take a pre-booked shuttle or Grab to Ngurah Rai International Airport (allow 1.5–2 hours travel time from Ubud, plus 2–3 hours for international check-in). Arrive at the airport with plenty of time.
day_by_day.evening: Depart Bali with incredible memories of beaches, yoga, temples, volcanoes, and warm Balinese hospitality.

meals.breakfast: Light final breakfast at the hotel or a nearby café — fruit, toast, and Balinese coffee for IDR 20,000–40,000
meals.lunch: Quick warung meal near the hotel before departure, or airport food (budget IDR 50,000–100,000 at airport)
meals.dinner: Airport dining or on the flight

day_by_day.notes: Book airport transfer the night before. Allow extra time for July peak season traffic between Ubud and the airport — traffic can be heavy, especially in the afternoon. Keep IDR 200,000–300,000 in cash for airport tax or last-minute purchases. Selamat jalan — safe travels!

trip_options.title: Classic Bali Experience
trip_options.description: The sweet spot between comfort and value. Enjoy quality accommodations, diverse experiences, and good food.

hotel.name: Campuhan Ridge Walk, Ubud Boutique Stay

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Ngurah Rai International Airport at 13:00 — no morning activities scheduled. Arrange pre-booked airport transfer to Campuhan Ridge Walk, Ubud Boutique Stay (approx. 1.5–2 hr drive).
day_by_day.afternoon: Check in to the boutique stay, freshen up, and take a gentle introductory stroll along the iconic Campuhan Ridge Walk trail (2 km loop) — enjoy sweeping views of the jungle-lined river valley and rice paddies to ease into Bali time.
day_by_day.evening: Explore the charming Campuhan and central Ubud strip on foot. Browse local art galleries along Jalan Raya Campuhan before settling in for a relaxed welcome dinner.

meals.breakfast: N/A — in-flight meal
meals.lunch: Grab a light bite at the airport or a warungs (local eatery) near Ubud upon arrival — try nasi campur (mixed rice) for ~IDR 35,000–50,000.
meals.dinner: Swept Away Restaurant or Naughty Nuri's Warung, Ubud — mid-range Balinese grilled dishes and cocktails, budget ~IDR 150,000–250,000 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 light to recover from the flight. Confirm accommodation check-in time in advance. Exchange currency at the airport or use a reputable ATM in Ubud. Stay hydrated — warm humid weather expected (25°C+).

day_by_day.morning: Start with a sunrise yoga class at one of Ubud's renowned studios — Yoga Barn or Radiantly Alive offer morning Hatha or Vinyasa flow sessions (90 min, ~IDR 120,000–150,000). Return to the hotel for breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the sacred Pura Gunung Lebah temple at the base of Campuhan Ridge, then hire a driver for a half-day cultural loop: Tegallalang Rice Terraces (30 min north) and a stop at a traditional Balinese silver or wood-carving workshop in Celuk or Mas village.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a traditional Kecak Fire Dance performance at Pura Dalem Ubud or Arma Museum (starts ~18:30, ~IDR 100,000–150,000). Dinner in central Ubud afterward.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or Seniman Coffee Studio — avocado toast, fresh fruit, Balinese coffee, ~IDR 80,000–120,000.
meals.lunch: Warung Babi Guling Ibu Oka — famous suckling pig rice plate, ~IDR 60,000–80,000.
meals.dinner: Locavore NXT (casual sister restaurant) or Bridges Restaurant overlooking the Campuhan River — ~IDR 200,000–350,000 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Book yoga class and Kecak performance in advance during July (peak season). Bring a light rain jacket — 30 mm monthly rain means occasional afternoon showers possible.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning Campuhan Ridge Walk at sunrise (6:00–7:30 AM) for golden light and cooler temperatures — minimal crowds at this hour. Pack water and wear comfortable shoes.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Ubud Monkey Forest (Sacred Monkey Sanctuary) — a lush 12-hectare nature reserve with ancient temples and long-tailed macaques (~IDR 80,000 entry). Spend 1.5–2 hrs exploring, then browse Ubud Art Market (Pasar Seni) for batik, sarongs, and handicrafts.
day_by_day.evening: Take a traditional Balinese cooking class (evening session available at Paon Bali or Casa Luna Cooking School, ~IDR 350,000–450,000 per person) — learn to prepare 5–6 authentic dishes and enjoy your creation as dinner.

meals.breakfast: Café Pomegranate or Clear Café Ubud — smoothie bowls, granola, fresh juices, ~IDR 70,000–100,000.
meals.lunch: Warung Teges or Warung Ibu Rai near Monkey Forest — local nasi goreng or mie goreng, ~IDR 40,000–60,000.
meals.dinner: Included in cooking class (your own creation!). Supplement with dessert at Gelato Secrets Ubud — ~IDR 35,000.

day_by_day.notes: Wear closed-toe shoes at Monkey Forest and keep bags zipped — monkeys are playful thieves! Cooking class bookings fill fast in peak season; reserve ahead.

day_by_day.morning: Restorative morning: 90-minute Yin Yoga or Meditation session at Yoga Barn (~IDR 130,000). Follow with a traditional Balinese massage at a reputable spa near Campuhan — Uma Spa or Taksu Spa offer 60-min treatments (~IDR 200,000–300,000).
day_by_day.afternoon: Day trip to Tirta Empul Holy Water Temple (30 min from Ubud) — witness or participate in the sacred melukat purification ritual. Combine with a visit to Gunung Kawi ancient rock-cut temple shrines nearby.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud. Explore the vibrant night atmosphere of Jalan Hanoman — street food stalls, live music bars, and artisan shops.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or Kafe Ubud — full Balinese breakfast set with black rice porridge, ~IDR 75,000–100,000.
meals.lunch: Warung near Tirta Empul — fresh coconut, satay skewers, and tempeh, ~IDR 50,000–70,000.
meals.dinner: Mozaic Restaurant Brasserie or Hujan Locale — creative Indonesian cuisine, ~IDR 200,000–300,000 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Wear a sarong at Tirta Empul (provided at entrance for a small fee or bring your own). Respect temple etiquette — remove shoes and dress modestly. Bring a change of clothes if you plan to participate in the purification bath.

day_by_day.morning: Beach day begins! Early departure from Ubud to Seminyak or Canggu Beach (approx. 1–1.5 hr drive south — hire a private driver, ~IDR 300,000–400,000 round trip). Arrive for a morning surf lesson at Canggu's Batu Bolong Beach (beginner-friendly, ~IDR 200,000–300,000 for 2-hr lesson with board and instructor).
day_by_day.afternoon: Relax on the beach, swim, and sunbathe. Rent a sun lounger (~IDR 50,000) and soak up the warm Bali sun. Explore the cool cafés and boutique shops of Canggu's trendy Batu Bolong strip.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the legendary Bali sunset from La Brisa or The Lawn beach club in Canggu — one drink minimum (~IDR 80,000–150,000). Head back to Ubud after sunset.

meals.breakfast: Early grab-and-go from a local bakery or hotel — banana pancakes and coffee, ~IDR 50,000.
meals.lunch: Betelnut Café or Old Man's, Canggu — burgers, fresh fish tacos, tropical smoothies, ~IDR 120,000–180,000.
meals.dinner: Stop in Seminyak on the way back — Sarong Restaurant or Sisterfields for a satisfying mid-range dinner, ~IDR 200,000–280,000.

day_by_day.notes: July is peak surf season in Bali — waves at Canggu are moderate, ideal for beginners with an instructor. Apply reef-safe sunscreen. Arrange driver the night before.

day_by_day.morning: Morning Pranayama (breathwork) and Vinyasa yoga session at Yoga Barn or a rooftop yoga class at your hotel if available (6:30–8:00 AM). Afterward, visit the Ubud Palace (Puri Saren Agung) — free entry, beautiful traditional Balinese royal architecture.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the Ubud region's artistic heritage: visit ARMA (Agung Rai Museum of Art) — excellent collection of Balinese and Indonesian masters (~IDR 80,000 entry). Stroll through the museum's lush tropical garden café for a refreshment break.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a Legong or Barong Dance performance at Ubud Palace (starts 19:30, ~IDR 100,000–150,000) — one of Bali's most captivating traditional dance forms.

meals.breakfast: Sayuri Healing Food — vegan/plant-based smoothie bowls and raw treats, ~IDR 80,000–120,000.
meals.lunch: ARMA Museum café — Indonesian rice dishes in a beautiful garden setting, ~IDR 100,000–150,000.
meals.dinner: Warung Biah Biah — authentic Balinese home-style cooking, very popular with locals and travelers, ~IDR 80,000–130,000.

day_by_day.notes: Check the Ubud Palace performance schedule in advance as different dances are performed on different nights. ARMA also occasionally hosts evening cultural events worth checking.

day_by_day.morning: Full day at Nusa Penida island — depart early from Sanur Harbor (1.5 hr drive from Ubud + 45-min fast boat, ~IDR 200,000–250,000 each way). First stop: iconic Kelingking Beach (T-Rex cliff viewpoint) — one of Bali's most photographed spots.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue to Crystal Bay — pristine turquoise waters perfect for snorkeling (equipment rental ~IDR 50,000). Visit Broken Beach (Pasih Uug) and Angel's Billabong natural infinity rock pool. Arrange a local scooter or private driver on the island (~IDR 150,000–200,000 for half day).
day_by_day.evening: Return fast boat to Sanur, drive back to Ubud. Relaxed evening — gentle walk along Campuhan Ridge at dusk.

meals.breakfast: Very early — grab nasi bungkus (wrapped rice) from a roadside warung en route to Sanur, ~IDR 20,000–30,000.
meals.lunch: Local warung near Crystal Bay, Nusa Penida — fresh grilled fish, rice, and vegetables, ~IDR 60,000–90,000.
meals.dinner: Café des Artistes or Warung Sopa, Ubud — relaxed dinner back at base, ~IDR 120,000–200,000.

day_by_day.notes: Nusa Penida is a full-day commitment — depart Ubud by 6:30 AM. Book fast boat in advance (Maruti Express or Rocky Fast Cruise). Wear sturdy shoes for Kelingking viewpoint trail. Bring cash as ATMs on the island are limited.

day_by_day.morning: Recovery morning after Nusa Penida. Sleep in, then enjoy a slow morning with a 60-minute restorative yoga or sound healing session at Yoga Barn (~IDR 130,000). Journal, read, or simply enjoy the hotel's surroundings.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Ubud's surrounding rice terraces by bicycle — rent a bicycle from town (~IDR 50,000–80,000/day) and cycle through Subak irrigation system fields around Campuhan and Sayan village. Stop at Sayan Terrace for views over the Ayung River gorge.
day_by_day.evening: Indulge in a luxurious 90-minute traditional Balinese boreh body scrub and massage at Karsa Spa (set in a stunning jungle ravine along the Ayung River, ~IDR 400,000–600,000) — a well-deserved mid-trip treat.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast — enjoy a leisurely meal, ~IDR 80,000–120,000.
meals.lunch: Sayan Terrace or a riverside warung — nasi campur with jungle views, ~IDR 80,000–130,000.
meals.dinner: Kebun Bistro, Ubud — cozy garden restaurant, Western and Indonesian fusion, ~IDR 150,000–250,000.

day_by_day.notes: Karsa Spa requires advance booking and is accessed via a steep jungle path — wear comfortable footwear. This is an ideal rest and recharge day at the midpoint of the trip.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning visit to Mount Batur (Kintamani region, ~1.5 hr from Ubud) — join a guided sunrise trek (depart 2:00–3:00 AM, ~IDR 350,000–500,000 with guide). Reach the 1,717m summit for a spectacular sunrise over the volcanic crater lake.
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend and soak in natural hot springs at the base of Mount Batur (~IDR 150,000 entry) to soothe muscles. Drive back toward Ubud via Kintamani village — stop at a local coffee plantation for a free luwak coffee tasting tour.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud. Light evening — gentle stretching, early dinner, and early bedtime to recover from the pre-dawn start.

meals.breakfast: Simple snack before trek (provided by guide or packed from hotel) — energy bars and bananas.
meals.lunch: Kintamani warung with panoramic volcano views — traditional Balinese buffet, ~IDR 80,000–120,000.
meals.dinner: Warung Pulau Kelapa or Bebek Bengil (Duck Restaurant) Ubud — famous crispy duck dish, ~IDR 150,000–250,000.

day_by_day.notes: Mount Batur trek requires a licensed guide (mandatory). Bring warm layers — summit temperature can drop to 10–15°C before sunrise. Headlamp, water, and snacks essential. Book guide the day before through your hotel or a reputable trekking agency.

day_by_day.morning: Second beach day — head to Balangan Beach or Bingin Beach on the Bukit Peninsula (approx. 1.5–2 hr drive south). These are quieter, cliff-backed beaches with crystal-clear water — ideal for swimming and snorkeling. Arrive early to claim a good spot.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Uluwatu Temple (Pura Luhur Uluwatu) — dramatically perched on a 70m sea cliff (~IDR 50,000 entry). Walk the cliff-edge path with panoramic Indian Ocean views. Stay for the famous Kecak Fire Dance at sunset (18:00, ~IDR 150,000).
day_by_day.evening: Dinner at Jimbaran Bay — choose from the famous seafood warungs right on the beach where tables are set on the sand. Fresh grilled lobster, prawns, and fish with sunset views (~IDR 200,000–400,000 per person). Return to Ubud.

meals.breakfast: Early departure — hotel breakfast or packed nasi bungkus, ~IDR 30,000–80,000.
meals.lunch: Small cliff-top warung at Bingin or Balangan — fresh coconut, grilled corn, light snacks, ~IDR 50,000–80,000.
meals.dinner: Jimbaran Bay seafood BBQ on the beach — Menega Café or Lia Café, ~IDR 250,000–400,000 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Balangan and Bingin beaches involve steep staircase descents — wear appropriate footwear. Keep bags secure at Uluwatu (monkeys present). Jimbaran seafood vendors are plentiful — compare menus and prices before committing.

day_by_day.morning: Dedicated yoga immersion morning: attend a 2-hour workshop at Yoga Barn (specialty class — Ashtanga, Aerial, or Chakra Balancing, ~IDR 150,000–200,000). Follow with a 30-minute meditation in the studio's garden.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Goa Gajah (Elephant Cave) — ancient 9th-century Hindu archaeological site just 4 km from Ubud center (~IDR 50,000 entry). Explore the cave shrine, bathing pools, and jungle terraces. Continue to Yeh Pulu — a nearby carved rock relief site off the beaten path.
day_by_day.evening: Ubud Night Market exploration — wander the evening market stalls near Ubud Traditional Market for local street food, grilled satay, martabak (stuffed pancake), and fresh fruit.

meals.breakfast: Kafe Ubud or Anomali Coffee — eggs Benedict, fresh juice, specialty Balinese coffee, ~IDR 90,000–130,000.
meals.lunch: Warung near Goa Gajah — local lunch set with soup, rice, and vegetables, ~IDR 50,000–70,000.
meals.dinner: Night Market street food feast — budget ~IDR 60,000–100,000 for a variety of local snacks, satay, and desserts.

day_by_day.notes: Goa Gajah requires a sarong (available at entrance). Yeh Pulu is a short walk from Goa Gajah through rice fields — bring good shoes. The night market is liveliest between 18:00–21:00.

day_by_day.morning: Final full beach experience — head to Seminyak Beach (1.5 hr drive). Morning swim and beach yoga on the wide sandy shore. Visit the stylish Seminyak Square area for last-minute boutique shopping — local fashion, jewelry, and homeware.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Petitenget Temple (Pura Petitenget) — a sea temple with excellent sunset potential. Walk north along the beach to Batu Belig for a quieter stretch of sand. Optional: paddleboard rental (~IDR 100,000–150,000/hr).
day_by_day.evening: Iconic Seminyak sunset at Ku De Ta or Potato Head Beach Club — enjoy a cocktail as the sun dips below the horizon (drinks from ~IDR 120,000). Farewell dinner in Seminyak before returning to Ubud.

meals.breakfast: Early hotel breakfast or Revolver Espresso, Seminyak — excellent coffee and brunch plates, ~IDR 100,000–150,000.
meals.lunch: La Lucciola, Seminyak — Italian-Indonesian beachfront dining, ~IDR 180,000–280,000.
meals.dinner: Merah Putih Restaurant, Seminyak — stunning architectural space, modern Indonesian cuisine — splurge-worthy farewell meal, ~IDR 300,000–450,000 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Seminyak is busier and more commercial than Ubud — keep an eye on belongings on the beach. Merah Putih is a special-occasion restaurant — book a table in advance. Arrange return transport to Ubud by 21:00–22:00.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise Campuhan Ridge Walk — a peaceful, reflective last morning stroll through the misty jungle ridge. Take photos, breathe in the Ubud air, and appreciate the journey. Return for a slow hotel breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Last-minute souvenir shopping at Ubud Art Market — pick up batik fabrics, wood carvings, silver jewelry, and Balinese paintings. Visit a local healer or energy balancing session if interested (Ubud is famous for traditional healers — arrange through hotel, ~IDR 200,000–350,000). Pack and check out.
day_by_day.evening: Depart for airport (allow 2–2.5 hrs from Ubud to Ngurah Rai Airport). Enjoy a final Balinese meal near the airport or at a departure lounge restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely final hotel breakfast — enjoy every bite, ~IDR 80,000–120,000.
meals.lunch: Warung Ibu Made or any central Ubud warung — one last nasi campur or mie goreng, ~IDR 40,000–60,000.
meals.dinner: Airport restaurant or final warung near Kuta/airport area — light meal before departure, ~IDR 80,000–150,000.

day_by_day.notes: Check flight departure time and arrange airport transfer through hotel (book the night before). Allow extra time for Bali traffic — July is peak season and roads can be congested. Declare any wooden or food items at customs. Carry a small bag with essentials accessible during the drive.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Bali Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

hotel.name: Campuhan Ridge Walk, Ubud Boutique Stay

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight LH arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Private airport transfer to Campuhan Ridge Walk, Ubud Boutique Stay. Check in, unwind with a welcome drink and a relaxing soak in your private villa pool. Take a gentle orientation stroll along the iconic Campuhan Ridge Walk trail just steps from the hotel to soak in the lush green valley views.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails on the hotel terrace overlooking the ridge, followed by a leisurely first dinner at the resort restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable (in-flight)
meals.lunch: Light refreshments provided during private airport transfer or a welcome platter at check-in
meals.dinner: Dinner at Bridges Bali Restaurant, Ubud — an iconic fine-dining venue perched above the Campuhan River gorge, renowned for its contemporary cuisine and dramatic setting

day_by_day.notes: Arrival day — keep the schedule relaxed to allow for jet lag and immigration/baggage formalities. Pre-arrange a private luxury car transfer from Ngurah Rai International Airport. Confirm early check-in with the hotel if possible.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise yoga session on the hotel's open-air pavilion or a private hilltop yoga class arranged by the resort overlooking the Campuhan Ridge. Follow with a healthy breakfast and a guided morning walk along the full Campuhan Ridge Walk trail (approx. 9 km round trip) through rice paddies and jungle.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary in central Ubud, then explore Ubud's renowned art galleries including the Puri Lukisan Museum and Neka Art Museum. Browse the Ubud Art Market for premium batik, silver jewellery, and handcrafted goods.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a traditional Kecak Fire Dance performance at Pura Dalem Ubud or the Ubud Palace (Puri Saren Agung), followed by dinner in the heart of Ubud.

meals.breakfast: Elaborate Indonesian and Western buffet at the resort restaurant — fresh tropical fruits, jamu shots, and freshly brewed Balinese coffee
meals.lunch: Lunch at Locavore NXT, Ubud — an innovative plant-forward fine-dining experience using hyper-local Balinese ingredients
meals.dinner: Dinner at Mozaic Restaurant Gastronomique — Ubud's most celebrated fine-dining destination with a French-inspired tasting menu and wine pairing

day_by_day.notes: Book Mozaic and Locavore NXT well in advance as they are highly sought after. Kecak performances typically begin at 18:30 — arrive 30 minutes early for good seats.

day_by_day.morning: Private Balinese cooking class at a premium culinary studio near Ubud — learn to prepare traditional dishes such as bebek betutu, lawar, and black rice pudding using organic ingredients sourced from the resort's garden. Begin with a guided visit to a local market.
day_by_day.afternoon: Indulge in a signature 3-hour Balinese spa journey at the resort or at COMO Shambhala Estate — including a full-body boreh scrub, floral bath, and traditional massage. Rest poolside afterwards.
day_by_day.evening: Private romantic candlelit dinner set up on the Campuhan Ridge with panoramic valley views, arranged by the hotel's concierge team.

meals.breakfast: In-room breakfast served on your private terrace — freshly squeezed juices, tropical fruit platter, eggs to order, and Balinese black rice porridge
meals.lunch: Enjoy the dishes you prepared during the cooking class as part of the experience
meals.dinner: Private candlelit ridge dinner curated by the resort chef — multi-course Balinese tasting menu with paired wines

day_by_day.notes: Book the COMO Shambhala spa in advance. The private ridge dinner requires at least 48 hours' notice with the hotel concierge. Ideal for a special occasion or honeymoon evening.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning private yoga and meditation session at Yoga Barn, Ubud — one of Bali's most prestigious wellness centres. Choose from Hatha, Vinyasa, or Yin yoga followed by a pranayama breathwork session.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private guided tour of the Tegalalang Rice Terraces — explore the iconic UNESCO-recognised UNESCO-listed subak irrigation system. Continue to Tirta Empul Temple for a guided spiritual purification ritual (melukat) in the sacred spring waters.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the hotel for sunset cocktails, then dinner at a top Ubud restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Healthy wellness breakfast at Yoga Barn's café — smoothie bowls, avocado toast, and cold-pressed juices
meals.lunch: Lunch at Swept Away at COMO Shambhala Estate — an elegant open-air riverside restaurant serving nutritious, beautifully presented cuisine
meals.dinner: Dinner at Hujan Locale — a refined Indonesian restaurant celebrating regional cuisines from across the archipelago with a sophisticated modern presentation

day_by_day.notes: Bring a sarong and sash for the Tirta Empul temple visit (available to borrow at the entrance). The melukat ritual is a deeply respectful spiritual experience — dress modestly and follow your guide's instructions. Book Yoga Barn classes 24 hours in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Full-day excursion to Bali's north coast. Depart early by private chauffeured car to Mount Batur for a sunrise trek (approx. 2 hours up) — witness breathtaking views over Lake Batur and the volcanic caldera at dawn.
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend and drive to the natural hot springs at Toya Devasya or Batur Natural Hot Spring for a restorative soak. Continue to Kintamani for lunch overlooking the volcano.
day_by_day.evening: Scenic drive back to Ubud through Penelokan and Bangli. Evening at leisure — relax at the resort.

meals.breakfast: Pre-dawn light snack provided by the trekking guide (banana, boiled eggs, toast) at the summit
meals.lunch: Lunch at Lakeview Restaurant, Kintamani — panoramic caldera views with an extensive Balinese and international buffet
meals.dinner: Casual in-room dining or light dinner at the hotel restaurant — grilled fish, fresh salads, and tropical desserts

day_by_day.notes: Mount Batur trek departs around 04:00 AM. Wear layers as the summit is cool at dawn (around 15°C). Book a certified guide through the hotel concierge. Trekking poles and headlamps are recommended.

day_by_day.morning: Private transfer to Seminyak/Petitenget beach area (approx. 1.5 hours from Ubud). Morning spent at a premium beach club — enjoy a luxury sun lounger setup, ocean swim, and beach yoga session at Potato Head Beach Club or Ku De Ta.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Seminyak's upscale boutiques and concept stores along Jalan Petitenget and Jalan Kayu Aya. Visit Deus Ex Machina for artisan coffee, then browse premium Balinese fashion at Biasa and Bamboo Blonde.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails at Ku De Ta or Merah Putih rooftop with Indian Ocean views, then dinner in Seminyak before returning to Ubud.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at the resort before departure — full Indonesian spread with freshly baked pastries
meals.lunch: Lunch at Merah Putih — a stunning split-level restaurant in a soaring bamboo-and-steel pavilion, serving elevated Indonesian cuisine
meals.dinner: Dinner at Sarong Restaurant, Seminyak — a glamorous Asian-fusion fine-dining experience in an ornate heritage setting

day_by_day.notes: Arrange a return private transfer to Ubud in the evening. Beach clubs can be busy on weekends — reserve a daybed in advance. Seminyak is approximately 75 km from Ubud; allow 1.5–2 hours each way.

day_by_day.morning: Wellness morning at the resort — begin with a 90-minute private Yin yoga and sound healing session in the open-air pavilion. Follow with a guided journaling and mindfulness walk along the Campuhan Ridge at a leisurely pace.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Blanco Renaissance Museum in Campuhan — a flamboyant artist's mansion showcasing the works of Antonio Blanco. Explore the nearby Penestanan artists' village and visit local painters' studios for an authentic cultural immersion.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset at the hotel terrace, followed by a Balinese healing session with a local balian (traditional healer) arranged by the concierge — a uniquely spiritual Balinese wellness experience.

meals.breakfast: Smoothie bowls, overnight oats, and herbal teas at the resort wellness café
meals.lunch: Lunch at Room4Dessert — a celebrated avant-garde dessert and savoury tasting experience by world-renowned pastry chef Will Goldfarb
meals.dinner: Dinner at Deer Duck Bistro, Ubud — a sophisticated bistro with French-Balinese fusion cuisine and an outstanding natural wine list

day_by_day.notes: The balian healing session is a profound cultural experience — approach with openness and respect. Some sessions involve offerings and prayer. Confirm availability and appropriateness with your concierge. Room4Dessert requires advance reservations.

day_by_day.morning: Private day trip to the Sidemen Valley — one of Bali's most unspoiled and scenic areas. Morning guided walk through emerald rice terraces and traditional Balinese villages, with views of Mount Agung. Visit a local weaving cooperative to observe traditional songket and endek silk weaving.
day_by_day.afternoon: Picnic lunch in the rice fields, then visit Pura Besakih — Bali's Mother Temple, the largest and most sacred Hindu temple complex on the island, dramatically set on the slopes of Mount Agung.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud. Unwind with a couples' or solo massage at the resort spa before dinner.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at the resort — eggs Benedict, fresh juices, and Balinese coffee
meals.lunch: Gourmet picnic basket prepared by the resort chef — served in the rice fields of Sidemen Valley
meals.dinner: Dinner at Alaya Resort Ubud's Plantation Restaurant — elegant garden dining with a refined Balinese menu and live acoustic music

day_by_day.notes: A sarong is mandatory at Pura Besakih — available at the entrance. Hire a certified local guide for the temple visit to navigate the complex respectfully and knowledgeably. The Sidemen Valley is approximately 45 minutes east of Ubud.

day_by_day.morning: Private transfer to the Bukit Peninsula (Uluwatu area, approx. 2 hours). Morning surf lesson or paddleboard session at Balangan Beach — a pristine, uncrowded beach with crystal-clear turquoise water and dramatic white limestone cliffs.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the clifftop Pura Luhur Uluwatu temple — one of Bali's six key temples, perched 70 metres above the Indian Ocean. Explore the cliff path with sweeping ocean panoramas. Relax at a premium clifftop beach club such as Single Fin or Sundays Beach Club.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the legendary Kecak Fire Dance at Uluwatu Temple at sunset — one of Bali's most dramatic cultural performances set against the ocean backdrop.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at the resort before departure
meals.lunch: Lunch at Single Fin, Uluwatu — a stylish clifftop bar and restaurant with stunning surf views and a creative international menu
meals.dinner: Dinner at Sundara at Four Seasons Resort Jimbaran Bay — a beachfront fine-dining restaurant with sand-between-your-toes dining, fresh seafood, and spectacular sunset views

day_by_day.notes: The Kecak Dance at Uluwatu begins at approximately 18:00 — arrive by 17:30. Wear a sarong at the temple. Book Sundara restaurant in advance. Consider staying overnight in Uluwatu/Jimbaran for a more relaxed experience before returning to Ubud the next day.

day_by_day.morning: Morning at leisure in the Jimbaran/Uluwatu area. Sunrise beach walk along Jimbaran Bay, followed by a private yoga session on the beach arranged through the Four Seasons or Bulgari Resort. Swim in the calm, warm waters of Jimbaran Bay.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private transfer back to Ubud. Stop en route at the Garuda Wisnu Kencana Cultural Park to see the iconic 120-metre GWK statue — one of the world's tallest statues. Explore the park's cultural performances and Balinese artisanship exhibitions.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort. Relaxing evening — private sunset yoga on the ridge, followed by a quiet dinner.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at the beachfront café in Jimbaran — fresh-caught grilled fish, tropical fruits, and local Balinese coffee
meals.lunch: Lunch at GWK Cultural Park's premium restaurant, or a packed gourmet lunch box from the resort
meals.dinner: Dinner at Murni's Warung, Ubud — a Ubud institution since 1974, set in a dramatic four-storey riverside setting with authentic Balinese cuisine and a legendary cocktail list

day_by_day.notes: The drive from Jimbaran to Ubud takes approximately 1.5 hours. GWK is conveniently located on the route back. Consider arranging a private cultural guide for the GWK visit.

day_by_day.morning: Full immersive wellness day. Begin with a 7:00 AM Ashtanga yoga class at The Yoga Barn, followed by a 60-minute Balinese massage. Mid-morning crystal singing bowl meditation session at a local wellness centre in Ubud.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the Ubud Botanic Garden (Kebun Raya Bali) in nearby Bedugul — a stunning 157-hectare highland botanical garden set at 1,400 metres elevation with cool misty air, rare orchids, and a sacred lake temple, Pura Ulun Danu Beratan.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud. Farewell-style premium dinner at one of Ubud's finest restaurants.

meals.breakfast: Post-yoga wellness breakfast at The Yoga Barn — açaí bowls, green smoothies, and raw energy balls
meals.lunch: Lunch at Café Lotus, Ubud — a beloved garden restaurant overlooking the lotus pond and Pura Taman Saraswati temple, serving refined Balinese and international cuisine
meals.dinner: Dinner at Métis Restaurant & Gallery, Ubud — a French-Mediterranean fine-dining experience in a stunning colonial villa surrounded by rice fields and art installations

day_by_day.notes: Kebun Raya Bali is approximately 45 minutes north of Ubud near Bedugul. The highland area can be cooler and misty — bring a light jacket. Book Métis in advance as it is consistently one of Ubud's most popular fine-dining venues.

day_by_day.morning: Final full morning in Bali — sunrise private yoga and breathwork session on the Campuhan Ridge. Slow, mindful morning walk through the ridge trail one last time, pausing to absorb the views of the jungle and river valley below.
day_by_day.afternoon: Last-minute premium shopping in Ubud — visit the Ubud Art Market for final gifts, artisan crafts, and keepsakes. Stop at a luxury spa for a final 2-hour pamper session — choose a signature treatment such as the Balinese Royal Lulur ritual.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset farewell cocktails at the resort terrace. Final premium dinner in Ubud to celebrate the journey.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely full breakfast at the resort — choose your favourites from the entire menu
meals.lunch: Lunch at Naughty Nuri's Warung — a legendary Ubud institution famous for its fall-off-the-bone BBQ pork ribs and potent martinis
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner at Hana, Ubud — an intimate Japanese-Indonesian omakase experience with premium sake pairings and exquisite seasonal ingredients

day_by_day.notes: Begin packing this evening. Confirm departure transfer details with the hotel concierge. Settle any outstanding spa or room charges. Check if the hotel offers a late checkout option for the following morning.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in Ubud. Wake early for one last sunrise over the Campuhan Ridge from the hotel terrace. Enjoy a leisurely checkout breakfast. Collect any pre-ordered artisan items or gifts arranged by the concierge.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private luxury transfer to Ngurah Rai International Airport, Denpasar. Allow 2 hours for the journey from Ubud. Enjoy the premium airport lounge before departure.
day_by_day.evening: Departure. Carry with you the memories of 13 extraordinary days in Bali — yoga on the ridge, sacred temples, volcanic sunrises, and world-class cuisine.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — a special send-off spread with all your favourite Balinese morning dishes, freshly pressed juices, and a farewell jamu tonic
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the Ngurah Rai International Airport premium lounge or a quick stop at a café en route to the airport
meals.dinner: In-flight dining

day_by_day.notes: Checkout is typically at 12:00 — negotiate a late checkout (14:00) if your flight allows. Ensure all souvenirs comply with customs regulations (no fresh produce, certain wood items may require documentation). Tip your villa attendants, driver, and guide generously — gratuity is warmly appreciated in Balinese culture.
